name: vesper-drift-video
description: Remotion project for the Vesper Drift / R7 Orbit vlog (rough cut + final).

scripts.render:rough: npm run edl && npm run prep && npm run srt && node scripts/render.mjs out/rough-cut.mp4 --scale=0.5 --props=props/rough.json --crf=26 && npm run verify -- out/rough-cut.mp4
scripts.render:final: npm run edl && npm run prep:1080 && npm run srt && node scripts/render.mjs out/final-1080p.mp4 --props=props/final.json --crf=18 && npm run verify -- out/final-1080p.mp4
